title: Muscle Gate — Sports Nutrition & Supplements Platform
tagline: Full-stack commercial e-commerce engineered for sports nutrition with multi-attribute filtering, Upstash Redis caching, and bilingual search architecture.

Automated order dispatch pipelines integrated with Telegram Bot and WhatsApp APIs
Structured bilingual JSON-LD Schema (OnlineStore, Product, FAQPage) engineered for search discovery
